story: Stage 5 was shortened by 2.2 km on the final climb. Early attacks mostly failed until a group featuring Ciccone, Piganzoli, Soler, Rubio, and Lecerf broke away. Red Bull chased them down, catching Ciccone last, before Jonas Vingegaard attacked with around 6 km to go and won ahead of Gall and Martínez.
